items.prompt: Why do we model real objects with geometric solids?
items.answer: To estimate their size, capacity, or material using formulas

Explain how modeling a water tank as a cylinder helps estimate how much it holds.
items.answer: By treating the tank as a cylinder, you can measure its radius and height and apply $V=\pi r^2 h$ to estimate its capacity, which would be hard to measure directly.
